definitions.explanation: Any vehicle used for transportation, including cars, trains, bicycles, etc.
An attraction at an amusement park that people ride on.

examples.japanese: どんな{乗|の}り{物|もの}で{来|き}ましたか。
examples.english: What kind of transportation did you come by?

examples.japanese: {乗|の}り{物|もの}に{酔|よ}いやすい。
{遊園地|ゆうえんち}の{乗|の}り{物|もの}に{乗|の}った。
examples.english: I rode the rides at the amusement park.

notes:
{乗|の}り{物|もの} is composed of {乗|の}る (to ride) + {物|もの} (thing).

TYPES OF 乗り物:
- {電車|でんしゃ}: train
- バス: bus
- {車|くるま}: car
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}: bicycle
- {飛行機|ひこうき}: airplane
- {船|ふね}: ship/boat

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {乗|の}り{物|もの}{酔|よ}い: motion sickness
- {乗|の}り{物|もの}に{乗|の}る: to ride a vehicle
- {公共|こうきょう}{乗|の}り{物|もの}: public transportation
